temperature.note: Every spectrum of Capella is the blended light of both giants, and the secondary is the brighter in the Hipparcos band, (l_B/l_A)_Hp = 1.204 +/- 0.060 (Torres et al. 2015, ApJ 807, 26, Table 4), so no archive spectrum is the primary's own, so the color is a Planck spectrum at its published temperature.
